text_block_list.name: Pecorine
text_block_list.text: It's still before Christmas, but watching the city's atmosphere is exiting, my heart began to flutter with excitement. Surely the people in the town must feel the same way. This is definitely going to be a great Christmas, isn't it?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
まだクリスマス前ですが、
街の様子を見ていたら
心が
ワクワクしてきました。
きっと街の人も同じ気持ちのはず。
これは絶対にいいクリスマスにしなきゃですね！
